statement:

The refund has been successfully created for $249.00 (24900 cents) on charge ch_3PkY7SIx1a2b3c for customer A. Whitfield. I corrected the amount from the 249000 cents shown in the request record, as that would have been $2,490.00 - ten times the original charge amount and more than the shop's available balance.
